title: Factory event log line
description: One line of the hook event log, one JSON object per line, files .factory/local/events/<UTC date>.jsonl (hooks.md 2.12). The Python writer loads this file and validates every event against it before writing, so the shipped schema cannot drift from the code; the documented event types are the table tables/event-types.toml. The writer's stricter millisecond timestamp is applied in py/vsdd/events.py, which refuses a line of its own making that is not exact.

ts.description: ISO 8601, UTC: whole seconds from the launcher, milliseconds from the Python writer (enforced by the writer itself).

session_id.description: Null on a launcher-written line: the shell cannot know the session.

cwd.description: The working directory the payload carried, on the lines about a tool call.

story.description: The story id whose worktree the call works in, on the lines about a tool call.

detail.description: Free-form payload; string leaves are redacted like every other field.
